title: Etale heart bounds control cohomological ranges on pro-etale complexes of etale origin
statement:
Let $f:X	o Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $B$ be a finite commutative ring with its discrete topology. Use constant coefficient sheaves, ordinary etale and pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], site comparison $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and ordinary total derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $N\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $R^qf_{\mathrm{et},*}M=0$ for every etale sheaf $M$ of $B$-modules and every integer $q\geq0$ with $q>N$. Let $a\leq b$ be integers and let $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ be bounded. Put $C=
u_X^*L$ and assume $\mathcal H^r(C)=0$ for $r
otin[a,b]$, using the cohomology of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $\mathcal H^r(L)=0$ for $r
otin[a,b]$ and
$$\mathcal H^i(Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C)=0\quad	ext{for }i
otin[a,b+N].$$
If $N<0$, both $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L$ and $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C$ are zero. No constructibility or Tor amplitude is assumed for $L$, and no cohomological bound on arbitrary pro-etale sheaves is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08J5, remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle (successive cohomology triangles); Tag 05TC, lemma-negative-vanishing. Combined with proetale.tex Tag 09A6, lemma-morphism-comparison, and exact fully faithful comparison pullback. This extracts old proof step 6, using the existing lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude rather than duplicating its general finite-truncation statement.

proof.text: The comparison unit is invertible by lem-weil-pbc-comparison-grothendieck-unit, so comparison inverse image on fixed-scalar module sheaves is faithful. The canonical intrinsic coefficient realization is an exact equivalence by def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules. Their composite is therefore exact and faithful. The existing exact-functor homology comparison and its zero-reflection lemma transfer the assumed range [a,b] of the intrinsic comparison image back to L. In particular L is bounded below by a; the separately supplied boundedness witness is unnecessary.

Let F be the ordinary unbounded etale right derived direct image of def-weil-pbc-direct-image. It is triangulated and commutes with integer shifts by lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated. On a degree-zero sheaf its negative cohomology vanishes: use the existing source lemma isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor from the PlusCompatibility module, the unbounded injective-resolution form of lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing. The ordinary ModuleCat-valued sheaf categories already have the necessary Grothendieck and K-injective instances, so no separate ringed-module construction is used.

Apply lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude to F and the class of all heart objects. If N is nonnegative, negative vanishing and the supplied bound together put every derived heart image in [0,N], so the lemma gives the range [a,b+N] for F(L).

If N<0, all cohomology of every derived heart image vanishes: negative degrees by Step 2, and nonnegative degrees by the supplied hypothesis, since each is greater than N. Fix an output degree i and apply the same bounded-heart amplitude theorem with c=d=i-a+1. Its heart hypothesis holds because all heart-image cohomology is zero; i<a+c gives vanishing in degree i of F(L). Since i was arbitrary, the existing source theorem DerivedCategory.isZero_of_forall_isZero_homology gives F(L)=0. This is exactly finite successive-cohomology devissage, without a degree-zero delta-functor or a new unproved statement.

View L as an object of D+ using the lower bound from Step 1. The canonical qcqs comparison prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image is invertible. Compose it with the exact-comparison D+/D compatibility and src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility on both sites, obtaining comparison of the unbounded direct images at L. Apply the canonical intrinsic realization and the section-normalized K-injective derived direct-image comparison supplied by def-weil-proetale-inverse-image to identify the result with the stated intrinsic pro-etale direct image. Exact comparison preserves homology vanishing and zero objects. Transport the range of Step 3 when N is nonnegative, and the zero object of Step 4 when N is negative. The latter also gives vanishing in every degree even when b+N<a.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J5 (remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle) and 05TC (lemma-negative-vanishing), via the proved bounded_heart_amplitude theorem; canonical qcqs comparison through prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image, D+/D compatibility, and the existing section-normalized intrinsic coefficient transport. For N<0 apply the same finite amplitude argument with c=d=i-a+1 in each degree, then use detection of zero by homology.

lean.statement: theorem etaleOrigin_pushforward_amplitude {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B] (N : ℤ) (_hN : ∀ (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))) (q : ℤ), 0 ≤ q → N < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))) (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b) (L : FiniteCoefficientEtaleDerivedCategory X (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) (_hL : ∃ c d : ℤ, c ≤ d ∧ ∀ r : ℤ, r < c ∨ d < r → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ r).obj L)) (_hC : ∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ r).obj ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X B).obj L))) : (∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ r).obj L)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b + N < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f B).obj ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X B).obj L)))) ∧ (N < 0 → IsZero ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj L) ∧ IsZero ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f B).obj ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X B).obj L)))
